title: enbridge buy salt creek midstream crude gathering assets 600 million 2026 08 26
text:
Aug 26 (Reuters) - Pipeline operator Enbridge (ENB.TO)
, opens new tab
 said on Wednesday it would acquire Salt Creek Midstream's crude oil gathering business ​for $600 million in cash, expanding its presence in ‌the crude-rich Permian Basin.
The Permian Basin, the largest oil-producing region in the United States, continues to attract investment in gathering ​systems and pipeline networks as companies work ​to transport crude volumes through export terminals on ⁠the U.S. Gulf Coast.
